name: SHS VIVEON AG
summary: SHS VIVEON AG provides consultancy and software solutions for the management of credit risks in Europe. It offers DebiTEX solution for credit management; GUARDEAN RiskSuite for risk management; and proofitBOX, a risk management solution for e-commerce. The company serves financial services, trade, e-commerce, industry, telecommunications, and energy sectors. SHS VIVEON AG was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.
